Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

To both parties: the $6.00 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-00209 is not chargeable, and the refund of $6.00 already showing on the ledger (payment_status REFUNDED, refund_issued_sgd 6.00) stands. No money moves on this ruling. Why: POL-NS-01 lets a driver keep a no-show fee only if all four of its conditions hold. The waiting condition, limb (c), requires the driver to hold position inside the pickup geofence for the free waiting period of 300 seconds, and POL-NS-01(c) measures that dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the driver's 'arrived' tap. On EV-GPS-00209 (weight 1.0, complete, no issues) the only qualifying run inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius lasts 236 seconds, from 07:44:14 to 07:48:10, which is 64 seconds short of 300. POL-NS-06 is strict on a shortfall: the fee is refunded in full and no driver compensation is payable, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied. On the driver's points: the 10.1-minute wait in the trip record (EV-TRIP-00209, weight 1.0) is a real measurement, but it runs from the 07:38:05 button marker, which POL-NS-01(c) does not accept as the start of the clock; the qualifying dwell begins 369 seconds after that marker. Your arrival on the trace and the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW are accepted (the limb (d) elements are present), but arrival alone does not carry the fee, the dwell does, and it falls short. No traffic advisory exists in the record (EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0), so the separate-interval summing in POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable. No false-arrival referral is made: POL-NS-05(ii) applies only where the trace shows no qualifying in-geofence fix at all, and here there are 25. On the rider's points: your track stays inside the 200 m presence radius throughout (greatest distance 91.7 m), but you sent no locating or coordinating message, so POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you; it does not need to, because the fee fails on the driver's own trace. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00209) is impaired at weight 0.85 with issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE, both driver messages and the system notice carrying read_at null; I name it and its discount, and say it does not carry the deciding fact, which rests on the driver's complete trace at weight 1.0, so the finding survives. Because the fee does not stand, POL-NS-07 (80 per cent = $4.80) is not reached and no driver compensation is due. This is a driver-filed dispute asking for the $6.00 to be restored; under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION means the filing party's claim is not supported and the ledger is left as it is, which on a driver-filed dispute over a fee already reversed leaves you, the rider, refunded. The monetary effect is $0.00, below the $8.00 execution threshold. Open question for the record, not a referral: the arrival marker at 07:38:05 precedes the first qualifying in-geofence fix by 369 seconds, but no derived figure states the driver's distance or speed at the marker, so POL-NS-05 cannot be run to a finding and produces no referral.

How to appeal: POL-GEN-04. Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 0.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

On EV-GPS-00209 (weight 1.0, complete, no issues) the only qualifying run inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius lasts 236 seconds, from 07:44:14 to 07:48:10, which is 64 seconds short of 300. POL-NS-06 is strict on a shortfall: the fee is refunded in full and no driver compensation is payable, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied. On the driver's points: the 10.1-minute wait in the trip record (EV-TRIP-00209, weight 1.0) is a real measurement, but it runs from the 07:38:05 button marker, which POL-NS-01(c) does not accept as the start of the clock; the qualifying dwell begins 369 seconds after that marker.
